raw_prompt: !create add a new skript that spawns a pig with it scaled up. Have it tied to a command, spawnbigpig. op only
reviewer_feedback: Created a new command /spawnbigpig that spawns a pig scaled to 5.0 times its normal size.
usage_instructions: Type /spawnbigpig to summon a giant pig at your current location.

mutations.content:
command /spawnbigpig:
    permission: op
    trigger:
        spawn a pig at player
        set {_pig} to last spawned entity
        set scale of {_pig} to 5.0
        send "&aSpawned a giant pig!" to player

traces.intent_summary: Create an operator-only command /spawnbigpig that spawns a pig with a scaled-up size attribute.

traces.rationale: Created a simple command script that spawns a pig and uses the 'set size of' syntax to scale it up. This requires the Skript-reflect or similar addon that supports entity scaling, as standard Skript does not natively support entity size modification without NMS or specific addons.

traces.error_trace:

    size of {_pig} can't be set to '5' because the latter is not a text
    Line: set size of {_pig} to 5
 
[Skript] Encountered 1 error while reloading giant_pig.sk! (35ms)

traces.rationale: The error occurred because the 'size' property in Skript (often provided by addons like ModelEngine or MythicMobs, or native entity scaling) expects a number, but the syntax parser was misinterpreting the assignment. Using a float (5.0) ensures the value is treated as a number. I have wrapped the logic in a standard command block with the requested OP permission.
